source_screen.method: publisher project page and official code repository metadata only

task_fit.native_task: pixel-level segmentation of sound-producing object(s) in video frames
task_fit.potential_value: direct audio-video correspondence and sound-source localization
task_fit.both_modalities_matter_claim: publisher defines an audiovisual localization task; no project model evaluation was performed

limitations: dataset is explicitly CC BY-NC 4.0 and is not admitted to the product-directed source pool
native output is a segmentation mask rather than probabilities over supplied options
underlying video media rights need separate consideration
processed video/audio access requires a publisher email request; none was sent
recommendation: Do not use for product training or product-quality claims. Reconsider only as a separately scoped noncommercial sound-source-grounding research benchmark.
